goal: map pca_N features to their top-3 loading genes for the SHAP figures
outcome: PUBLISHED - verified against the shipped scores

previous_state.why: the shipped expression_pca128_breast.parquet could not be reproduced from the Model.csv at that time

root_cause: Notebook 01 section 8 wrote wanted_breast_ids.csv with pandas' default header; section 9a read it back with header=None.
That injected a phantom cell line '0' into the wanted set, so the RandomState(42) holdout draw differed from an intended run.
The shipped expression_pca128_breast.parquet was produced with that phantom, so reproducing it requires the historical draw (--pool phantom, the default).
The notebook bug is fixed (section 8 now writes header=False); a fresh run produces a cleaner basis and requires retraining.

checks.components_not_attributable_reason: zero-variance residual direction of the sample space; carries no signal, loadings numerically unstable

verification_method: Reconstructed scores = scaled_expression @ components.T, matched per component against the shipped expression_pca128_breast.parquet via Hungarian assignment on |corr|; only components with |r| > 0.999 and max reconstruction error < 1e-2 are published with gene names.
safe_conclusion: Every attributable PCA feature consumed by the CatBoost model now has a verified gene-level label; pca_61 is deliberately left unattributed and flagged in the dashboard.
how_to_reproduce: python src/models/pca_loadings.py  # default --pool phantom reproduces the shipped basis
